maddeler.e:
أتنافس (form VI)
# أَتَنَافَسُ (ʔatanāfasu) /ʔa.ta.naː.fa.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَنَافَسَ (tanāfasa)
# أَتَنَافَسَ (ʔatanāfasa) /ʔa.ta.naː.fa.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَنَافَسَ (tanāfasa)
# أَتَنَافَسْ (ʔatanāfas) /ʔa.ta.naː.fas/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَنَافَسَ (tanāfasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
